candidate: Scope a Null-display shortcut to owned packed battles; validate and watch actual default arrays, then skip the repeated speed-override lookup while the watched version is unchanged.
must_preserve: Never assume all C++ contexts or all arrays are default; ordinary/direct C++ and noncanonical input retain old reads.
Keep canonical array identities and values. Reuse the existing array watcher for aliases and all array mutations.

The active-cooldown recovery suffix uses the same item_tick lambda, so a phase-constant true flag is UNSAFE. Recheck the captured version and watch validity at every item, including recovery.

refined_design.private_scope: Create only inside run_one_internal after startBattle, before the physical loop; restore previous scope on exit for nesting/thread isolation.
refined_design.registration: Validate the live character inventory items, their gems, owned stat arrays (all Null), and all watch compatibility before attaching any watch. Watch inventory/gems too, so newly inserted owners cannot evade invalidation.
refined_design.reuse: Attach the existing NativeTimerWatch to the owned stat arrays; array aliases and every existing mutation API then change the same structural version. The CoreItem statDisplayOverrides setter must invalidate before replacing a registered field.
refined_design.hot_loop: Capture a nonzero valid scope version once per active-cooldown phase. The item_tick lambda must compare current version AND watch validity at each item, including the recovery suffix, before passing a fourth assume-default argument to native_frame_segment_tick.
refined_design.layout: Keep GdArr/GdDict/BattleCtx and generated object layouts unchanged. The scope is private engine state; no global container-head growth and no snapshot cache required.
refined_design.tests: Use actual final-DLL functions plus a scope test interface to force fast hits, then mutate future owners through alias/setStat/field setter, array APIs, nested phases and recovery. Verify ordinary C++ contexts do not enter the private scope.
refined_design.remaining_risk: Raw C++ writes bypassing mutation APIs are outside the private packed entry; prove no such write or externally exposed object pointer exists in that entry. Retain the entire old path elsewhere.
